summary: Ultrapar Holdings Inc. (via its Brazilian subsidiary Ultrapar Participações S.A.) filed a Form 6-K reporting board approval of a share buyback program. The company may repurchase up to 18,000,000 common shares (1.61% of capital stock) on B3 S.A. over 12 months ending June 17, 2027. The buyback is for stock-based incentive plans, treasury holding, or subsequent cancellation—no stated price or premium. No advisor or recommendation mentioned. The program complies with CVM Resolution 77/22. What to watch: pace of repurchases and potential for cancellation as a value-return signal; no risk-arb angle given open-market execution.
